description: Get VNC console access details for a VPS. SENSITIVE — the response may carry a one-time console URL or session credential that grants direct machine access. Hand it to the user who asked for it and nothing else: do not log it, do not repeat it in a summary, and treat it as expiring.

userId.description: Account id, or the literal "self" for the authenticated account. Defaults to "self".

vpsId.description: VPS id or name, as returned by ws_vps_list.

name: ws_vps_vnc
title: Get VPS console access
